question.title: The mode and order of understanding

articles.groundTruthTitle: Whether our intellect understands corporeal and material things by abstraction from phantasms?
Whether the intelligible species abstracted from the phantasm is related to our intellect as that which is understood?
Whether the more universal is first in our intellectual cognition?

articles.groundTruthTitle: Whether we can understand many things at the same time?
